source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A sign generally pointing toward a serious surgical complication requiring immediate emergency intervention right away","B":"An expected part of routine anesthesia recovery that would not typically call for any particular ongoing monitoring","C":"Malignant hyperthermia, since agitation and confusion are thought to commonly represent this life-threatening reaction","D":"Emergence delirium, a relatively common, generally self-limited phenomenon during anesthesia recovery, requiring a calm, safe approach"}}
source_row.rationale: Emergence delirium is a relatively common, generally self-limited phenomenon during anesthesia recovery, involving agitation, confusion, and sometimes combativeness, requiring a calm, safe nursing approach while ruling out other causes of altered mental status.
source_row.source_detail: Recognition and Approach to Emergence Delirium
